summary: Fix the knowledge graph failing to draw similarity relations: the camera started from the paper being read even when that paper was not drawn (collapsed category, removed paper, other project), so a missing node's position was read. The origin is now chosen among drawn nodes (graphOrigin) and the neighbouring position reads are guarded.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode on top of fc4929f. Front-end fix only.

budget_impact.rationale: Front-end fix; no model call, no data change, no network.
budget_impact.before: Opening the knowledge graph with the current paper hidden raised an error and the similarity view did not draw.
budget_impact.after: It draws, starting from the first drawn node.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; window not clicked through

open_risks: Checked in a Chromium-based preview with a copy of the real data, not in the Tauri/WebKit window.
